comment: At ladrone.cpp:149 the third group's first oscillator multiplies its knob by inputs[CV_H1_I1] instead of inputs[CV_H3_I1], so the jack at input 9 never reaches the oscillator drawn beside it and the jack at input 1 reaches two oscillators. The sum used for normalisation at ladrone.cpp:161 loops over every input, so input 9 still changes the overall level. That is why input 9 has its own line. The waveforms are at ladrone.cpp:139 to :157: within each group the first term is sin(ramp times pi) and the others are sin(ramp times another ramp times pi), which the maker's README calls a sort of phase modulation. Group g runs its ramps at g times the base frequency.
